definition: Market Risk Premium (R_m - R_f): Value-weighted excess return of the broader investable universe over 91-day T-bill
missing_value_treatment: Dropped first month (1993-10) where MF is NaN

definition: Risk-Free Rate: Monthly equivalent yield derived from 91-day Government of India Treasury Bills
source: Reserve Bank of India (RBI DBIE via IIM-A)
transformation: Monthly compounded yield from primary auction cut-offs
missing_value_treatment: Dropped first month (1993-10) where RF is NaN

definition: Small Minus Big: Return spread between small-cap and large-cap stock portfolios across value dimensions
transformation: Formed from 2x3 sorts (Size 90th percentile, B/M 30th/70th percentiles)
lag_applied: Annual reconstitution in October using September data (~6 month accounting lag)

definition: High Minus Low: Return spread between high book-to-market (value) and low book-to-market (growth) portfolios
transformation: Formed from 2x3 sorts (Size 90th percentile, B/M 30th/70th percentiles)
lag_applied: Annual reconstitution in October using March fiscal-year end financial statements (6-month lag)

definition: Winners Minus Losers (Momentum): Return spread between past top 30% winners and bottom 30% losers over prior 2-12 months
transformation: Formed from 2x2 sorts on Size (90th pct) and Prior Return (t-12 to t-2)
lag_applied: Monthly rebalancing; 1-month skip to avoid bid-ask bounce / short-term reversal

definition: Small Value Portfolio Return: Small-cap High-B/M portfolio return
Small Neutral Portfolio Return: Small-cap Medium-B/M portfolio return
Small Growth Portfolio Return: Small-cap Low-B/M portfolio return
Big Value Portfolio Return: Large-cap High-B/M portfolio return
transformation: Value-weighted monthly return; dropped in months with <5 stocks
missing_value_treatment: Missing in 154 months due to diversification filter (<5 stocks); analyzed with pairwise-complete or balanced 9-portfolio subsets

definition: Big Neutral Portfolio Return: Large-cap Medium-B/M portfolio return
Big Growth Portfolio Return: Large-cap Low-B/M portfolio return
Winners Small Portfolio Return: Small-cap high prior momentum portfolio return
Winners Big Portfolio Return: Large-cap high prior momentum portfolio return
Losers Small Portfolio Return: Small-cap low prior momentum portfolio return
Losers Big Portfolio Return: Large-cap low prior momentum portfolio return
